title: Hyaluronan-mediated motility receptor regulating the Wnt/beta-catenin signaling resulting in hepatocellular carcinoma by inhibiting the phosphorylation activity of GSK-3beta.
authors: Zhang, Yumei; Zhang, Zhiming; Yan, Zongcai; He, Meiling; Wang, Xiuwen
one_liner_zh: 该研究聚焦HMMR调控Wnt/β-catenin信号促进肝癌进展，仅用分子对接验证蛋白-蛋白结合，无蛋白质-DNA互作、TF-DNA体系或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC), the most common primary liver cancer, remains a major global health burden due to its aggressive metastatic behavior and poor prognosis. Clarification of the molecular basis underlying metastasis and recurrence is essential for advancing therapeutic development. The present study examines the contribution of hyaluronan-mediated motility receptor (HMMR) to HCC progression and its clinical implications. METHODS: Eighty paired HCC tumor and adjacent non-tumor tissues were obtained from patients who underwent radical resection. HMMR expression was evaluated by immunohistochemistry, Western blotting, and quantitative real-time PCR (qPCR). Kaplan-Meier and Cox regression analyses were employed to determine the association of HMMR expression with overall survival (OS) and recurrence-free survival (RFS). Functional assays were performed in Huh7 and Hep3B cells with HMMR knockdown or overexpression, including CCK-8 assays for proliferation, Transwell assays for migration and invasion, and Western blotting/qPCR for assessing epithelial-mesenchymal transition (EMT) markers (E-cadherin, N-cadherin, vimentin) and Wnt/beta-catenin signaling components (GSK-3beta, beta-catenin, cyclin D1, c-myc). A subcutaneous xenograft model in nude mice was established to evaluate the effect of HMMR on tumor growth in vivo. Gene set variation analysis (GSVA) and molecular docking were applied to investigate HMMR-related pathways and potential protein-protein interactions. RESULTS: HMMR expression was markedly elevated in HCC tissues compared with adjacent tissues (p < 0.001) at both mRNA and protein levels. Patients with high HMMR expression exhibited reduced median OS (27.8 vs. 32.3 months, p = 0.012) and RFS (9.6 vs. 12.6 months, p = 0.017). In vitro experiments demonstrated that HMMR silencing suppressed Huh7/Hep3B cell proliferation, migration (p < 0.01), and invasion (p < 0.001), while increasing E-cadherin and GSK-3beta expression and reducing N-cadherin, vimentin, beta-catenin, cyclin D1, and c-myc. Conversely, HMMR overexpression produced opposite effects. In xenograft models, tumors with HMMR knockdown displayed slower growth. GSVA indicated a positive correlation of HMMR expression with EMT and Wnt/beta-catenin signaling, and molecular docking confirmed the binding capacity of HMMR to GSK-3beta and beta-catenin. Mechanistic analysis showed that HMMR suppressed GSK-3beta phosphorylation activity, limiting beta-catenin ubiquitination and degradation, thereby activating Wnt/beta-catenin signaling and driving EMT. CONCLUSIONS: HMMR stabilizes beta-catenin by suppressing GSK-3beta phosphorylation activity, which reduces beta-catenin ubiquitination and degradation. Knocking down HMMR enhances GSK-3beta expression and its degradative effect on beta-catenin, thereby lowering beta-catenin protein levels.
abstract_zh: 背景：肝细胞癌（HCC）是最常见的原发性肝癌，因其侵袭性转移行为和不良预后，仍是全球重大健康负担。阐明转移和复发背后的分子基础对于推进治疗发展至关重要。本研究探讨了透明质酸介导的运动受体（HMMR）在HCC进展中的作用及其临床意义。方法：从接受根治性切除的患者中获取80对HCC肿瘤组织和相邻非肿瘤组织。通过免疫组织化学、Western blotting和定量实时PCR（qPCR）评估HMMR表达。采用Kaplan-Meier和Cox回归分析确定HMMR表达与总生存期（OS）和无复发生存期（RFS）的关联。在Huh7和Hep3B细胞中进行HMMR敲低或过表达的功能实验，包括用于增殖的CCK-8实验、用于迁移和侵袭的Transwell实验，以及用于评估上皮-间质转化（EMT）标志物（E-cadherin、N-cadherin、vimentin）和Wnt/β-catenin信号通路组分（GSK-3β、β-catenin、cyclin D1、c-myc）的Western blotting/qPCR。建立裸鼠皮下异种移植模型以评估HMMR对体内肿瘤生长的影响。应用基因集变异分析（GSVA）和分子对接研究HMMR相关通路及潜在蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用。结果：与相邻组织相比，HCC组织中HMMR表达在mRNA和蛋白质水平均显著升高（p < 0.001）。高HMMR表达患者的中位OS（27.8 vs. 32.3个月，p = 0.012）和RFS（9.6 vs. 12.6个月，p = 0.017）降低。体外实验表明，HMMR沉默抑制了Huh7/Hep3B细胞增殖、迁移（p < 0.01）和侵袭（p < 0.001），同时增加E-cadherin和GSK-3β表达，并降低N-cadherin、vimentin、β-catenin、cyclin D1和c-myc。相反，HMMR过表达产生相反效果。在异种移植模型中，HMMR敲低的肿瘤生长较慢。GSVA显示HMMR表达与EMT和Wnt/β-catenin信号通路正相关，分子对接确认了HMMR与GSK-3β和β-catenin的结合能力。机制分析表明，HMMR抑制GSK-3β磷酸化活性，限制β-catenin泛素化和降解，从而激活Wnt/β-catenin信号通路并驱动EMT。结论：HMMR通过抑制GSK-3β磷酸化活性稳定β-catenin，从而减少β-catenin泛素化和降解。敲低HMMR增强GSK-3β表达及其对β-catenin的降解作用，从而降低β-catenin蛋白水平。
